During the [[Pre–Shadow Hand campaign|campaigns]] to reconquer the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] in [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]] and the resulting [[Imperial Civil War]], a '''battle''' occurred at the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Chasin]]. The [[Vengeance-class dreadnought|''Vengeance''-class dreadnought]] [[Javelin (Vengeance-class)|''Javelin'']] rammed into the [[Unidentified Torpedo Sphere (Chasin)|Torpedo Sphere]] guarding Chasin, destroying both.
